RagShortTexts: The House of Este held the lush Po river delta, fielding white eagle banners for the papal.

Variants.Content: Mastering Ferrara, Modena, and Reggio, the House of Este under Obizzo II commanded the strategic Po river delta. Waving their noble white eagle crest, they stood as paramount champions of the Guelph cause against Ghibelline encroachments.
Control over vital delta salt waterways funded formidable mercenary navies, shielding Ferrara from land invasions.
